$comment: Safety allowlist (requirement 3.4). Enforced at a single chokepoint every action passes through, shared by discovery and replay. Enforcement lands in Phase 5; the contract is fixed here so nothing is written against a moving target.
$comment_denied: /admin/** is the fault-injection control surface. Denying it to the agent is not decoration: an agent that could reach it could disable the very failure conditions the safety model exists to handle, or reconfigure the app out from under a replay. The control plane must be unreachable from the data plane.
$comment_actions: Action types are allowlisted, not blocklisted. A new action kind is unusable until it is named here — the failure mode of a missed blocklist entry is silent permission, which is the wrong default in a regulated environment.
